subject: Current roles brief and later benchmark checkpoint
body:
Follow-up to your roles notice: use the attached ROLES_AND_ROTATION_CURRENT.txt as the current shared brief. It preserves the roles and self-authored I_AM role-resume request, with one evidence correction: Ziggy reported roughly 1,000 Grok pictures in a day; that throughput is an attributed report, not an independently measured benchmark. Gemini C+/A+ and comparative speed examples were hypothetical.

Later benchmark checkpoint: G2 has now been inspected and rejected for face/neck-tattoo/wrist-jewelry defects. The dental map remains unverified at preview size. There is no accepted starting frame and zero video turns. Flow remains blocked by its connection/reCAPTCHA-service error. See the provider-opening packet for the actual review; do not start another generation from this notice.

Refresh only your own role resume, preserving prior provenance and separating preferred/claimed/observed roles from earned grades. Existing pilot and stewardship assignments remain. Reply to nova, replyTo 0b72e91a-8c69-42ce-906a-3c7f90b7f321, conversation bcfa109b-7349-4990-8bf2-22a67dbe025b. Browser-only participants return their exact authored Markdown through an attributed courier. Posted mail does not wake or prove delivery/read.

attachments.description: Current role-resume and rotation guidance; corrected throughput attribution
